purpose: Stable discovery catalog for the complete Trinity Accord recovery set, including versioned Zenodo recovery publications, encrypted delayed-access witness archives, and separately scoped institutional mirrors.

core_repository.resolution_rule: Resolve the concept DOI and select its latest published version.
core_repository.coverage_rule: Each version restores the exact immutable Git-tracked publication baseline named in its manifest; no version claims byte equality with a later moving GitHub main.

final_evidence_freeze.scope: 8 Bitcoin inscriptions, 10 non-NFT Ethereum anchors, 175 Chronicle NFTs, frozen proof primitives, unified machine inventory and recovery topology

verified_arweave_mirror.scope: Exact non-authoritative repository preservation capsule mirror; external evidence and Chronicle NFT annex payloads remain separately mirrored and referenced.

current_evidence_checkpoint.historical_scope_note: Immutable checkpoint v4 predates the 12-item Bitcoin v2 proof and remains correctly described as an 8-Bitcoin publication baseline.

current_git_verified_bitcoin_proof.published_repository_version_boundary: The current verified v2 proof is Git-tracked after the currently named checkpoint DOI. Do not attribute v2 bytes to an older DOI; resolve the concept DOI after the next verified publication.

encrypted_witness_archives.security_boundary: Public preservation contains ciphertext plus recovery/integrity/verification metadata and deletion/destruction receipts; no public plaintext source material or unlock material is intentionally included.

cold_recovery_integration.integration_rule: Do not treat this layer as part of the GitHub-independent core recovery order until a later verified core repository version contains this index and these DOI pointers.

first_star_moon_witness.role: non-amending computationally delayed witness preservation archive

second_star_moon_witness.role: non-amending computationally delayed witness preservation archive

bubble_constellation.role: non-amending computationally delayed witness preservation archive

harvard_dataverse.verification_rule: Treat Harvard as publicly verified only when preservation/harvard-dataverse-state.json has status=complete and public_readback_verified=true for the exact archive SHA-256 and byte count.

relationship_to_zenodo.scope_note: The Harvard object is a broader, later full-project preservation bundle assembled from the named Git source, every GitHub Release asset, and the separately published Polygon/Base DOI. It is not a new version of the Zenodo concept DOI and no byte-equality claim is made against Zenodo repository version 10.5281/zenodo.22020122.

recovery_order: Resolve and restore the latest core repository version from concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21739343, or retrieve the exact verified Arweave repository capsule mirror identified in core_repository.verified_arweave_mirror.
Verify the recovered preservation manifest and tracked-file inventory.
Read api/final-evidence-inventory.v1.json and api/evidence-relationship-map.v1.json to identify authority, proof, mirror and preservation roles without conflating them.

Run the checked-in current offline verifier for the 12-item Bitcoin v2 snapshot, plus the Ethereum and 175-item NFT verifiers; when restoring an older DOI, respect that version's historical Bitcoin scope.

If preservation/harvard-dataverse-state.json records status=complete, Harvard DOI 10.7910/DVN/YUCG12 is an independently verified second-institutional full-project mirror and may be used as an additional recovery source; do not substitute its scope for the frozen Zenodo checkpoint semantics.
Verify Bitcoin Originals, authority manifests, signatures, digest manifests and corrections-index before making authority-level claims.
github_independent_scope_note: The two false flags apply to the currently verified core repository and binary-annex recovery order only. The encrypted delayed-access witness index remains outside that order until a later verified core repository version contains it.
